descripcion:
What if everyone woke up with $1 million tomorrow? In just 3 days, one loaf of bread costs $50,000 — and only ONE person on the street actually comes out ahead. 🍞💸

This is hyperinflation, and it really happened: Germany 1923 and Zimbabwe 2009, where a 100-trillion-dollar note was worth about $30.
